nodes.long_description: A car stadium environment, the track has a mat and a wooden sled with a dummy on top of it, the experiment is conducted from the viewing area, there are 3 bombs labeled sandpaper, glass, and OHP film, grab one of them and throw it on the mat, if it hits the mat well, the bomb will explode and the surface of the mat will change to the corresponding material, Adjust the button to gradually increase the angle of the mat, and at a certain angle, a wooden sled will roll down the sled with a human model holding up a hand, repeat 4 times for each material bomb and average the values to learn about the friction of different materials.
nodes.short_description: Uncover the force that opposes motion. This experiment explores how frictional force works and its impact on movement, providing insight into a fundamental force in physics.

nodes.long_description: "Dive into the realm of realistic experiments through Virtual Reality (VR). Experience the excitement of conducting actual reactions in a risk-free digital laboratory. Mix substances, observe genuine changes, and engage with lifelike molecular structures—all in an immersive 3D environment. Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and substances, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
